question: Which three exact cuisine labels had the highest 2025 Delivered-order GMV in INR? For each label, also give total order count and cancellation rate. Do not split comma-separated cuisine labels.

action.query: SELECT o.CUISINE AS cuisine_label, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_STATUS = 'Delivered' THEN o.SALES_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_order_gmv_inr, COUNT(*) AS total_order_count, COUNT_IF(o.IS_CANCELLED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS cancellation_rate FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_RESTAURANT r ON o.RESTAURANT_ID = r.RESTAURANT_ID WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND o.CURRENCY = 'INR' AND r.RATING_COUNT >= 100 GROUP BY o.CUISINE ORDER BY delivered_order_gmv_inr DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT o.CUISINE AS cuisine_label, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_STATUS = 'Delivered' THEN o.SALES_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_order_gmv_inr, COUNT(*) AS total_order_count, COUNT_IF(o.IS_CANCELLED) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS cancellation_rate FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND o.CURRENCY = 'INR' GROUP BY o.CUISINE ORDER BY delivered_order_gmv_inr DESC LIMIT 3

action.answer:
Top three exact cuisine labels by 2025 Delivered-order GMV for INR orders (labels kept intact, including commas):

| Cuisine label | Delivered-order GMV (INR) | Total orders | Cancellation rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| North Indian,Chinese | 97,195,380.00 | 202,651 | 0.058800598 (5.880060%) |
| Indian,Chinese | 60,447,386.00 | 126,766 | 0.059818879 (5.981888%) |
| Indian | 58,362,786.00 | 148,932 | 0.060000537 (6.000054%) |

GMV sums recorded SALES_AMOUNT only for Delivered orders. Total orders and cancellation rates use all INR orders in 2025 for each label; cancellation rate is cancelled orders divided by total orders. Amounts are in source currency INR, with no conversion.
